description: Background flight recorder that captures server warnings, errors, tracebacks, run outcomes and tool metrics for after-the-fact diagnosis. Logs self-prune (row + age caps) to keep storage bounded. All knobs are adjustable in app-settings.json — defaults in brackets: diagnostics_enabled [true], diagnostics_ring_size [4000 — in-memory live-feed records], diagnostics_retention_rows [200000 — max rows kept in logs.db], diagnostics_retention_hours [168 = 7 days — max age of durable rows], diagnostics_persist_level [info — minimum level written to logs.db], diagnostics_file_logging [true — per-source text files], diagnostics_log_dir [logs], diagnostics_log_max_bytes [5000000 = 5 MB — rotation size], diagnostics_log_backups [3 — rotated files kept per category]. Changes apply after a restart.
